mostWorthwhile.text: Rebuilding the food web and joining it to the woodland made recovery feel like connected processes rather than a simple reversal of extinction.

leastWorthwhile.text: Checking the fruit and woodland after the habitat goal was complete yielded no partners, making the search for the remaining connection repetitive.

surprise.text: The earlier insect-and-flower combination was unavailable until the woodland had produced returning pollinators; recovery had to begin with the habitat.

arbitrary.text: The final pairing of spreading mammals with returning pollinators was not obvious to me, though its explanation connected fruit, feeding and dispersal clearly afterward.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the recovering world makes next; the branching mammal habitats and the ending's acknowledgement of irreversible loss gave it a compelling direction.
